title: imageio-ffmpeg is not in the dependency lock — a full engine reinstall kills ALL video output
description: MpiSaveVideo is our node and hard-requires ffmpeg, but the dependency is declared only in comfyui-videohelpersuite/requirements.txt. Pin it in dev_configs/python_deps.in and recompile.

attention.reason: Fix committed (13014988) and proved on the dev engine: the drift gate flips to DRIFT without the pin, and ensureCuratedPythonDeps() reinstalls imageio-ffmpeg into a stripped engine with get_ffmpeg_exe() resolving. The one product-level check is unrun - no mp4 has rendered since the fix.
